item: The import re-index writer flushes once per article and counts the script check per distinct letter (row 406, R824 step 4)
summary: The single writer inserted each new keyword in its own flush; it now inserts an article's new keywords in one flush with the same ids, tags and mentions. The script check looked up a Unicode name per letter; it now counts per distinct letter with the same share. Measured on 4 cores: re-index 40.7 to 51.5 articles/s on 2,000 synthetic articles; a 2,000-article import 68 to 55 s. Database contents identical to main apart from timestamps.
